source_integrity_policy: Original MP4/model caches retained. Manifest source SHA256 reused; source size/mtime checked by transcription. Full source hashes were not recomputed by final verification.
limits: Machine ASR not human-listened or word-accuracy scored.
VAD segment source timestamps, not forced-aligned word timestamps.
Full decoded input coverage is not a claim of complete or accurate speech recognition.
Korean/English source-film clips may contain garbled text; course-card summaries rely on readable continuous Chinese teaching.
Assignment completeness comes from sequential machine-transcript reading, not keyword scanning or this technical audit.
